DIN adapter plates

Black PETG plates between your bought DIN clips (blue ghost) and the parts (grey ghost). Drag to orbit, scroll or pinch to zoom.

TB6600 plate (×3)

  • A 3 mm organic frame: a spine under the wall, two seat ribs, and curved struts between them. About 23 cm³.
  • The driver sits on the two ribs, 8 above the clip. Each rib carries an insert pad.
  • The clip screws into M3 × 4 heat-set inserts (OD 4.3) pressed in from the underside: Ø4.0 bore, 4.5 deep, in 8 tall pads.
  • Two posts take the flange, 89 mm apart (the test print showed 87 was 2 mm short), slots ±1 mm. The slot runs 8–20 mm above the seat, with a nut channel outside.

Board plate (×1)

  • A 4 mm organic frame: struts flow from the 4 board bosses to the 4 insert pads, with two sweeping braces.
  • Clips turned 90°: the board sits on an uncut 8-inch rail running front to back under its centre line; the two clips sit 60 apart along that rail.
  • Insert pads 8 tall. The bosses rise to 12, which leaves 4 mm between the PCB's underside and the pads.
  • Board bosses take M3 × 4 brass inserts from the top; M3 × 6 pan heads through the PCB.

Need from you

  • Clip thickness at the screw holes, so I can size the flat-head M3 screws (thickness + about 5): unmeasured.
  • Height from the rail's base to the clip's top face when it's clipped on. My guess is about 16 (unverified).
